description: Read one MCP server's full listing in Stork's directory. Use this when the user asks about a specific server: who publishes it, how it connects, or whether its endpoint answered Stork's last check. Takes the listing slug from a search. Returns the listing, including `check` (what Stork's last request to its endpoint saw, with the estimated token size of its tool definitions) and `toolChanges` (each time a check found different tool definitions than the check before, and whether the server's version changed with them).
name: stork_server_details
